body: the fertilizer sack with a drained sprayer carry a greasy sheen from the fertilizer trial. they were packed before traffic was turned around.
title: fertilizer sack with a drained sprayer at saturday before sunrise
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a greasy sheen while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: A head count by the fire
body: Our camp was told the pickup would stop where the smoke could be seen. A vehicle came, copied the number of tents, and drove away before the sleeping people woke. The next day someone had crossed our site off the rescue map.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
